    getDataset

    • getDataset(): ReadonlyMapshaperDataset | undefined

      Returns a zero-copy, deep read-only TypeScript view of the live dataset.

      The view intentionally omits mutating ArcCollection methods and marks nested layers, shapes, records and metadata as read-only. Route changes through Emap.ops.*, Emap.editSession.* or an EditCommand so render caches, selection and history stay synchronized.

      This is a compile-time boundary, not a runtime clone: JavaScript, any and explicit type assertions can still bypass it.

      Returns ReadonlyMapshaperDataset | undefined

    setData

    • setData(data: TopologySourceInput): Promise<TopologySource>

      Replace the source's data and trigger a re-import.

      Accepts a URL, a single {filename, content} object, or an array of {filename, content} for multi-file imports (each file becomes its own layer in one dataset — same behaviour as mapshaper's -i FILE1 FILE2 ... CLI invocation).

      Returns a promise that resolves with the source once the import completes and rejects if it fails — await source.setData(...) is the canonical way to wait for the dataset. The data / error events still fire for event-driven consumers.

      Last-write-wins: rapid back-to-back calls supersede each other. Only the latest call's outcome fires data / error; in-flight URL fetches from superseded calls are aborted. A superseded call's promise resolves early (the newer call owns the next outcome) so awaiting it never hangs.

      Parameters

      • data: TopologySourceInput

        data accepts TopologySourceInput for setData. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to TopologySourceInput.

      Returns Promise<TopologySource>

      • Defined in src/source/topology-source.ts:277

    StaticfromBytes

    • fromBytes(
          id: string,
          bytes: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>,
          options?: TopologySourceFromBytesOptions,
      ): Promise<TopologySource>

      Convenience loader for in-memory bytes, e.g. files selected through an <input type="file">. Resolves after the import succeeds and rejects on the first load error.

      Parameters

      • id: string

        Required source id string; must be a valid unique source id for the target map. It cannot be omitted because the returned source is constructed with this id.

      • bytes: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>

        Required raw file bytes; must be a Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer containing GeoJSON, TopoJSON, Shapefile ZIP, or another supported format. Omitted bytes are invalid because mapshaper needs content to import.

      • Optionaloptions: TopologySourceFromBytesOptions

        Optional source settings. When omitted, filename defaults to ${id}.geojson; when supplied, filename must use a supported import extension such as .geojson, .topojson, .json, .zip, .shp, .kml, or .msx.

      Returns Promise<TopologySource>

      Example

      const response = await fetch('/data/points.geojson');
      const source = await TopologySource.fromBytes('points', await response.arrayBuffer(), {
        filename: 'points.geojson',
      });
